result.brief: 提出两阶段单图世界建模框架：先用 PaSS Flow 预测全局 3D 代理，再将视频扩散模型改造为生成式延迟精修器，实现可探索、几何一致的高保真场景生成。
result.reason: Image-to-scene generation with 3D proxy and video diffusion refiner; contributes generative latent/geometry representation for explorable world modeling, matching video world model and generation directions.
